newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to reopen state phone sale bidding process.
newsitem.headline: Panama to reopen state phone sale bidding process.

text.p: Panama is to reopen the pre-qualification process for the sale of its state-run telephone utility to allow more bidders to participate, a high-ranking government official said Tuesday.
The government will announce the date and conditions for the second pre-qualification process next week, Alfredo Macia, head of the government's privatization program, told Reuters.
The government had planned to sell 49 percent of Panama's National Telecommunications Institute (INTEL) later this year, but the process was derailed when key bidder SBC International pulled out.
The withdrawal left GTE Corp the only company qualified to participate.
SBC opted to participate in Brazil's more lucrative market where at least 15 telecommunications sales are planned, the smallest worth some $300 million, Macia said.
INTEL's value is estimated at $2 billion with assets of some $450 million, he said. Macia did not say when the INTEL sale would be finalized.
